title: BETSE model predicts HCN2 maintains the neural tube Vmem pattern despite nicotine

fields.label: Label
fields.value: BETSE model predicts HCN2 maintains the neural tube Vmem pattern despite nicotine

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The BETSE model predicts that uniformly expressed HCN2 channels, which open at hyperpolarized Vmem and so amplify small Vmem gradients, open preferentially in the Xenopus neural tube and maintain its hyperpolarized Vmem pattern even in nicotine-exposed model embryos.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Pai VP 2018, HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns › Results › BETSE model identifies HCN2 channel as a repair reagent

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Importantly, our model predicts that HCN2 expression leads to maintenance of neural tube Vmem pattern even in nicotine-exposed model embryos, similar to the action of IT (Fig. 3c vs. d, e, f).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Pai VP, Pietak A, Willocq V, Ye B, Shi NQ, Levin M, “HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns”, Nature communications (2018), doi:10.1038/s41467-018-03334-5; section “Results › BETSE model identifies HCN2 channel as a repair reagent”. Scope: BETSE model of the Xenopus neurula with HCN2 channels (mouse kinetics, Na+:K+ permeability ratio 0.2) and nicotine

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2018-hcn2-07: resolvable-now, resolvability 0.88

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The model conditions and predicted spatial voltage output make this directly computationally testable. Public BETSE code and published parameterization are likely adequate, although reconstructing an exact configuration may introduce uncertainty.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Run the specified BETSE model under control, nicotine, HCN2, and nicotine-plus-HCN2 conditions and compare neural-tube versus lateral Vmem patterns; maintenance under combined treatment confirms the simulation result.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Parameter uncertainty could permit multiple outcomes.

Paper-specific configuration files may need reconstruction from the supplement.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data existence: 0.82
analysis feasibility: 0.9
operationalizability: 0.98
discriminating power: 0.92
data adequacy: 0.78

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The prediction is a defined simulation contrast, and BETSE can run it once nicotine's Hill parameters are copied from the supplement. Those pharmacological constants are less completely fixed in the main text than the HCN2 switch itself, so a mismatch is ambiguous between a false prediction and a rebuilt model. The test can still reject a total loss of pattern or a reversal, which is a partial resolution of the stated prediction.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Add uniform HCN2 to the nicotine-exposed neurula model and compare the neural-tube-minus-lateral Vmem contrast with nicotine alone. Maintenance is confirmed if the contrast remains near the control pattern; collapse of the contrast to the nicotine-only pattern would refute the prediction.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
A reconstructed configuration can miss the published run even when the qualitative HCN2 switch is real.

Nicotine is implemented as a Hill function on nAChR and a partial HCN block whose constants sit in the supplement.
